facts: About 5,100 people in the district (2021 census)
In the north of Rarotonga, the largest of the Cook Islands
worth_knowing: The name means "two harbours" in Māori. The town is built around Avatiu Harbour, the main port, and Avarua Harbour, once the main port and now a small fishing port.
